_doc: Design-specific power models of the flyback stress fixture (the generic parts come from the skill's power-models.json).

models.source: DC operating-point stand-in for the 230 Vac line: the bulk capacitor charges to √2·230 V = 325.3 V less the bridge drops; line impedance + fuse ≈ 0.5 Ω. intent derive restores the AC envelope of the line nets (230 Vrms / 325 V peak).

Design operating point of the EE25 flyback transformer at regulation: TL431 holds VOUT = 12.0 V, so the secondary winding sits at VOUT + VF(SS310, 2 A ≈ 0.8 V) + the L1 drop ≈ 12.96 V; the aux winding (Na/Ns = 13/10) at 1.3 × 12.7 ≈ 16.5 V. The primary (switching) power is not a DC quantity and is not modelled.
Rated output of the product: 12 V / 2 A continuous (spec).
